name: v0.9.3
body:
## Ubuntu 24.04 (and other glibc 2.39 distros) work again

The x86_64 release builds were drifting onto a newer runner image and had started requiring **glibc 2.43**, so the tarball, `.deb` and AppImage would not start on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. This release pins both Linux builds to the **glibc 2.39** baseline (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS), and CI now measures the binary's maximum `GLIBC_*` requirement and fails on runner-image drift.

Verified on the published 0.9.3 assets: the x86_64 tarball's highest requirement is `GLIBC_2.39`, and the x86_64 AppImage launches (`muninn 0.9.3`).

## Security and maintenance

- CI now gates RustSec advisories, licences and dependency sources with `cargo-deny` and **no advisory ignores**; `anydoc 0.2.5` moved `zip` to 9.8.1, clearing eight inherited advisories.
- A scheduled fuzz harness covers the note-lock envelope, sync journal/commit JSON and wikilink parsers.

## Assets

Eleven files: Linux x86_64/aarch64 tarballs and AppImages, macOS aarch64 tarball, Windows x86_64 zip, both `.deb`s, `install.sh`, `checksums.txt` and the Sigstore bundle.

## What's Changed
* chore: refresh AUR and site snapshot for 0.9.2 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/261
* docs: publish the 1.0 compatibility contract (#251) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/262
* ci(security): add cargo-deny dependency policy (#249) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/264
* release: keep Linux builds on a glibc 2.39 baseline (#263) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/265
* docs(release): protect tags and document the rerun policy (#253) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/266
* test(security): fuzz the note-lock, sync and wikilink parsers (#248) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/267
* ci(fuzz): pin the GNU target so ASAN links by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/268
* Release 0.9.3: Linux glibc 2.39 baseline by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/269
